scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && rm -rf dist/*.js dist/chunks && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2020 --splitting --outdir=dist --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] && npm run copy-engine
scripts.copy-engine: node scripts/patchStockfish.mjs dist/engine && npm run build:tactics-worker -- --outfile=dist/engine/tacticsWorker.js
scripts.build:ext: tsc --noEmit && rm -rf ../extension/dist && esbuild src/extension/offscreen.ts src/extension/background.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --splitting --outdir=../extension/dist --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] && esbuild src/extension/content.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2022 --loader:.css=text --outfile=../extension/dist/content.js && node scripts/patchStockfish.mjs ../extension/engine && npm run build:tactics-worker -- --outfile=../extension/engine/tacticsWorker.js
